title: bulbinella squamea

It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma due to its expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
